comment: Face tuning for the webcam app. Saving this file reloads the app. 'gain' = how strongly your expression drives the model's shape of that name (higher = reacts sooner and further, 0 = off). 'limit' = the furthest that shape may go, 0 to 1 (1 = the full modelled shape). A name covers everything starting with it: eyeBlink covers eyeBlinkLeft and eyeBlinkRight. Shapes not listed use gain 1.5, limit 1.
jawComment: The lower jaw also opens with the measured gap between your lips, so the teeth part when you talk. 'fromLips' = how far the jaw drops for a given lip gap (about 2 matches your real opening, higher exaggerates, 0 = off). 'lipDeadZone' = how far the lips must part before the jaw starts to move (raise it if the jaw bobs while your mouth is shut).
fvComment: The 'f / v' trigger (lower lip under the top teeth). It fires only while the tracker sees your lips together AND the microphone hears an 'f' hiss or a 'v' voice; while it fires, the model makes its 'f / v' mouth (the mouthFV shape: like the kiss, but the bottom lip rides up to cover the bottom teeth and the corners drop a little) by 'strength', 0 to 1, and the jaw is held open by 'jaw' (0 to 1 of full travel) so the chin stays down while the lip rises. 'strength' 0 = off, and the microphone is not opened. More 'jaw' drops the chin further and shows more of the top teeth; less closes the mouth. 'lips' = the gap between your lips that counts as together: [fully on at or below, off at or above] (your 'f' measures about 0.013; raise both if it never fires, lower both if it fires on 's' or on vowels). 'voiced' = how far a voice with no hiss opens it, 0 to 1 (this lets 'v' through; 0 = 'f' only). 'release' = seconds it stays on after the sound stops. Press H to see the live 'f / v' line with the numbers.
landmarksComment: Nose scrunch and brow frown are also measured directly from the face landmarks, because the tracker's own scores for them barely move. Higher = reacts to a smaller scrunch / frown, 0 = off. Press C with a relaxed face so the app knows your relaxed measurements.
